name: DeepSeek
note: Quota only, and a balance rather than a meter: DeepSeek is pay-per-use and publishes no cap, so there is no percentage to report. One row per currency the account holds — the currency is read from the response rather than assumed, because Chinese accounts are billed in CNY and labelling that with a dollar sign would misstate the balance by an exchange rate.

compatibility.note: Mapping is fixture-verified against the published response shape; the numbers themselves are unconfirmed against a live account.
